name: Royal Dollar
oneLiner: RUSD is RIB / Royal Coins' centralized dollar stablecoin backed by issuer-managed cash and short-term liquid reserve assets with KYC-gated mint and redemption.
collateral: Issuer-managed fiat reserve assets and short-term liquid instruments disclosed by Royal/R Coins materials
pegMechanism: Centralized 1:1 dollar token with issuer-managed mint and redemption processes for approved users

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

reserves.name: Issuer-managed cash and liquid reserve assets

mintAuthority.summary: RUSD is RIB / Royal Coins' centralized dollar stablecoin (Hong Kong, same issuer as REUR); mint and redemption run through the issuer's backend for approved users against issuer-managed cash and short-term liquid reserves.

controls.label: RIB / Royal Coins issuance backend
controls.evidence: RIB/Royal Coins operates a centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for approved users against issuer-managed fiat and short-term liquid reserves; a single issuer controls supply creation.

review.evidence: RUSD whitepaper/Royal Coins materials describe a centralized 1:1 dollar token with issuer-managed mint and redemption for approved users against issuer-held cash and liquid reserves; the same issuer (RIB Digital Holdings) operates REUR, and no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain minter/owner role on the Ethereum/BSC/Tron RUSD contracts before raising confidence.
